article.linkText: North Alabama visits No. 17 Miami (FL) after Evbagharu's 27-point game
article.story: North Alabama Lions (2-1) at Miami Hurricanes (2-1) Coral Gables, Florida; Friday, 5 p.m. EST LINE: Hurricanes -34.5; over/under is 151.5 BOTTOM LINE: North Alabama visits No. 17 Miami (FL) after Michael Evbagharu scored 27 points in North Alabama's 81-72 loss to the Oklahoma Sooners. Miami (FL) went 26-9 overall with a 15-3 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Hurricanes averaged 81.5 points per game last season, 42.3 in the paint, 15.9 off of turnovers and 11.6 on fast breaks. North Alabama went 9-21 overall with a 4-12 record on the road a season ago. The Lions averaged 69.4 points per game last season, 14.6 on free throws and 17.4 from beyond the arc. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
